audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phase text is generic template using male pronouns for Akali and claiming Karma owns the lane ('the lane is a toll booth and you own it') at levels 4-5, which contradicts phases[3].side = Akali and the 35.71% win rate.
audit.why: Twilight Shroud (20/19/18/17/16s) makes her unselectable, which snaps the Focused Resolve tether before it roots and dodges autos; Karma's single-target threat disappears at 3.
audit.corrected: Karma owns level 1 only; level 2 is close; from 3 onward Shroud plus the Shuriken Flip recast hand Akali the lane, and she scales past it.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].side and win[4] both credit Karma with level 6, while whys[4] in the same file says the gap closes on Karma and Perfect Execution is a real kill spike.
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1, so 6 adds nothing for Karma, while Perfect Execution gives Akali two dashes and an execute on a 120/90/60s cooldown.
audit.corrected: Level 6 belongs to Akali; the packet chart agrees.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer mentions that Assassin's Mark turns her combo opener into an auto-attack reset, and the full layer never states what Shroud actually does to Focused Resolve.
audit.why: Her ring-exit empowered attack is an auto reset with bonus range — the wind-up, not the ability cast, is the tell to step back. Shroud makes her unselectable, breaking the tether.
audit.corrected: Step back on the Assassin's Mark wind-up, not on the spell cast; never commit Focused Resolve while she still holds Shroud.

audit.whatIsWrong: Content layer is written in first person ('my RQ', 'I open', 'not mine'), breaking the second-person coaching voice used everywhere else.
audit.why: The mirror audit flagged the same pronoun problem and left it unresolved.
audit.corrected: Converted whys[0..6], early, mid and late to second person at matched length.

edits.before: Level 1 is my one clean window — Mantra is up immediately, so I open RQ Soulflare the moment she steps up to last-hit and chunk her before she has W Twilight Shroud or her E dash to leave the zone. Stay on Q Inner Flame and the W Focused Resolve root at max range while she only has energy and one Q to answer with. The catch is level 3: once she gets her E shuriken recast and Shroud, she can dodge my AA, drop the cloud the instant I lock W and snap the tether before it roots, and her E-mark-into-Q burst comes online. My Q and RQ zone are skillshots so they still land through the cloud, but my single-target threat dies the second she can go invisible — so front-load every bit of poke in the first two levels.

edits.before: This is her lane now, not mine. From 3 onward she pokes with Q shuriken, uses W Twilight Shroud to dodge my AA and break the W tether mid-cast, and E-marks in for the Q-AA burst the instant my E Inspire shield is down. My level 6 is a non-event — Mantra is just the empower I've owned since level 1 — while her R hands her a two-part dash and execute, so the gap closes ON me here. Hold E Inspire purely for her all-in, never bleed it on trades, and don't try to land the W root when she's sitting on Shroud or near a wall to break line of sight. Concede CS, bank mana, and survive to be useful for the team.

edits.before: Akali is a hard scaler and this is where it hurts most. Past Hextech Rocketbelt and Shadowflame her energy-refunded E-Q-R combo one-shots my thin frame between Mantra cooldowns, and Karma has no late item spike to trade back — my whole identity is front-loaded early-mid pressure I already failed to convert. Shroud lets her dodge my AA and break the W tether in every skirmish, and her R reset lets her dive me even through an E Inspire shield. My only real job now is utility caster for the team: peel a diver off the carry with W, shield-and-speed an ally with E, and roam — do not try to solo her, because the 1v1 is lost the moment I'm out of E.

notes: Only 42 Emerald+ games, so nothing here leans on the 35.71% figure beyond direction. Full layer still carries template pronouns ('his farming spot', 'his engage') in tradeGood, dosFull[1].d and report[3].t; those are shared boilerplate strings reused across many Karma matchups, so I left them rather than risk a cross-matchup mismatch — worth a champion-level pass. Shroud's grounding/silence status, tenacity and whether Focused Resolve's root can land through the shroud's untargetability frame are not in the kit text; the untargetability breaking the tether is stated from Riot's own description only.
